contribution.donor_scope: within same dataset device and protocol; joint 8-dimensional vectors; no labels scores or capture roles; hash-ordered cyclic derangement; singletons unchanged
contribution.normalization: existing source FIT; zero denotes source mean in log-normalized coordinates, not no packets
contribution.thresholds: existing frozen thresholds; intervention decisions diagnostic only
contribution.reporting: primary cohort counts and RAW margins/deltas; full arrays HPC; no new efficacy claims or threshold/epoch selection

gradients.data: source LEARN/FIT only; source loader checks original UID and weight identities
gradients.sample: np default_rng(20261105) uniform FIT permutation first 16384 positions; same queries across snapshots; original n/batch weights
gradients.tail: full current-snapshot normal FIT tail, original mass and 128-negative sampler; counterfactual current-state diagnostic, not historic pre-step reconstruction
gradients.anchor: original lambda1, matched frozen REFIT782 targets and FIT scale
gradients.limitations: sampled gradient estimate; endpoint saturation/near-zero norms not proof of conflict; no Adam state replay; no external epoch scoring

preflight: fresh real112-row encoder/distance then small all-pool interventions and two real FIT gradient batches; measured gradient forecast required <=3600s
storage: large arrays and per-batch gradient diagnostics remain HPC; retrieve small summaries and SHA
external_role: consumed diagnostic evidence, not independent confirmation
